job.title: Application Consultant SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: Application Consultant SAP Commerce – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

You need an Application Consultant who connects business needs with SAP Commerce – I have done exactly that for 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

– Requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications and UAT with business teams
– 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 / 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell
– PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; SAP ERP / MDM integration

Supporting a global organisation like REHAU from a shared-services setup suits my experience with international stakeholders across regions. My CV and cover letter are attached. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Could we arrange a short call this week or next?

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Application Consultant SAP Commerce | Techno-Functional, Integrations | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce consultant with 5+ years supporting, extending and integrating enterprise B2B and B2C commerce applications (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Combines business requirements analysis, user stories, functional specifications and UAT with hands-on Java and Spring development, OCC REST APIs and PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP). Experienced in production support, CCv2 deployment cycles and working with international stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: REHAU runs SAP Commerce for a global industrial business, which mirrors my work for Rockwell Automation: B2B commerce, integrations with SAP ERP and PIM, and close work with business teams. In Global Business Services I can apply that techno-functional experience to keep your commerce applications stable and moving forward.

en.subject: Application: Application Consultant SAP Commerce
en.hook: As Application Consultant SAP Commerce you need someone who understands both the business processes and the platform underneath. That combination is my daily work: for more than five years I have analysed requirements with business teams and delivered the matching solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell – certified as both SAP Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

bullets.label: Business requirements to solution
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) – then translated them into working SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce application know-how
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211); developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and FlexibleSearch.

bullets.label: Integration with SAP ERP & PIM
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub; investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Stable application operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) in agile DevOps workflows; led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and supported production troubleshooting.
